# Pre-registration Template

This document serves as a pre-registration for your research study. Pre-registration helps ensure transparency and reduces the risk of questionable research practices by documenting your research plan before data collection begins.

**Registration platforms**: Consider registering this pre-registration on:

- [Open Science Framework (OSF)](https://osf.io/)
- [AsPredicted](https://aspredicted.org/)
- [ClinicalTrials.gov](https://clinicaltrials.gov/) (for clinical studies)
